name: TPB
title: Royals #1
desc: Readers are invited to the shadowy back alleys of Seoul, South Korea, for a thrilling, mind-bending crime caper unlike any other! Twin brothers Paul and Castor have crafted the perfect poker hustle using their uncanny telepathic connection. Perfect, that is, until they’re caught red-handed by the most ruthless criminal syndicate in Seoul. To pay them back, use their gift on a far grander scale than they’ve ever attempted and pull off the most dangerous heist of their lives… so long as they can manage to not kill each other first! From Eisner Award-winning writer DEREK KIRK KIM (THE LAST MERMAID, Same Difference) and rising star artist JACOB PEREZ (Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles). Collects ROYALS issues #1-6
